faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before getting started.

items.q: Is my data private and secure?
items.a: Yes. Your data is hosted in Europe on secure servers (Supabase / PostgreSQL). It is never sold or shared. You can delete your account and all your data at any time from the settings.

items.q: Can I cancel my subscription at any time?
items.a: Absolutely. No commitment, no hassle. You can cancel in one click from your settings. You keep Premium access until the end of the paid period.

items.q: What's the difference between Free and Premium?
items.a: The free version gives you 3 habits, 2 goals, 2 budget categories and 5 AI requests per month — more than enough to get started. Premium removes all these limits and adds advanced stats, downloadable reports, CSV export and themes.
{appName} is a Progressive Web App (PWA): you can add it to your phone's home screen from the browser for a near-native experience. A dedicated iOS/Android app is on the roadmap.

items.q: Is the AI assistant truly personalized?
items.a: Yes. The AI analyzes your habits, streaks, goals and budget in real time to give you advice tailored to your situation — not generic messages. It uses GPT-4o-mini from OpenAI.

items.q: What happens if I exceed the free limit?
items.a: You'll receive a clear message indicating the limit has been reached. Your existing data is preserved and you can still view it. Only creating new entries is blocked until you upgrade to Premium.
